sourceLabel: D. Bump, Math 263C Lecture 8 slides (Kauffman brackets and the Jones polynomial)
preciseLocator: Slides: Kauffman bracket definition; Theorem (invariance under Type O, II, III); curl computation <L>=-a^3<L'>; normalized bracket f(L)=(-a)^{-3w}<L>; Jones polynomial V_L(t)=f_L(t^{-1/4})
evidence: Read slides: skein recursion with loop factor d, curl removal giving -a^3, Type II and III computations, writhe normalization and change of variable to Jones V. Move diagrams are pictures, Type III is short.

sourceLabel: Aharonov-Jones-Landau, quantum algorithm for Jones polynomial, Sec 2
evidence: Read TL algebra, braid representation, Markov trace with properties tr(XY)=tr(YX) and Markov property (checked 'by pictures'), and identity of braid closure with Kauffman bracket. Alexander and Markov theorems and bracket invariance are only cited, so link invariance is not proved.

preciseLocator: Slides 'Knot invariants' to 'The Kauffman bracket as a quantum trace'
evidence: Read: links as ribbon-category morphisms, standard U_q(sl2) module R-matrix T with T^2=(q-q^-1)T+1, skein relation for quantum trace. Source says twist not computed and checks left to reader; Reidemeister I/II/III invariance and Yang-Baxter use not proved here.

sourceLabel: J. M. Lee, Riemannian Manifolds: An Introduction to Curvature (GTM 176), copy on Ranicki's Edinburgh page
preciseLocator: Ch. 10: Lemma 10.7, Lemma 10.8, Prop 10.9 (metric in normal coordinates, formula 10.8), Prop 10.10 (local uniqueness); pp. ~178-181
evidence: Read the proofs: Jacobi equation reduces to u''+Cu=0 with explicit solutions, Gauss lemma gives metric in normal coordinates identical to model, hence local isometry. Also Lohs notes Thm 4.2.4 (loeh.app.uni-regensburg.de) same argument. Hosting of the book copy may be unauthorized; Loeh notes are a legitimate alternative.

Searched for Frobenius/Pfaffian-system proof on frame bundles: read Lee GTM 176, Loeh lecture notes, Wang Lec10, de Bray M392C Lec18 (states Theorem 18.4, structure equations only, exercise), Falbel-Alexandre. None gives the O(M)xO(S) Pfaffian system with Frobenius argument.

Read: omega with Maurer-Cartan equation is locally f^*theta; constant curvature + zero torsion gives flat mutated geometry. Cor 6.22 is stated for complete case without proof, and the Riemannian specialization (Levi-Civita, kappa curvature, local isometry to sphere/Euclid/hyperbolic) is not carried out.

sourceLabel: U. Lim, Harmonic Forms, Hodge Theory and the Kodaira Embedding Theorem
preciseLocator: Sec 3.2: Props 3.2-3.3, Thms 3.1-3.4 (Hodge), Cor 3.1; also Etnyre notes Thm 1.22, Cor 1.23-1.24 (etnyre.math.gatech.edu/class/8803Fall18/Hodge.pdf)
evidence: Read: Green operator G, I=H+GDelta, commutation with d, exactness argument and uniqueness are fully proved. Missing: ellipticity of Laplacian not checked, PDO symbol lemma omitted, regularity only 'essentially'. Etnyre notes end with Gaarding/regularity (Thm 4.12) stated without proof.

sourceLabel: Etnyre, Class notes on Hodge theory
preciseLocator: Sec 1.3, Thm A, Thm B, proof of Hodge Thm 1.22; Cor 1.24
evidence: Read: Warner-style proof via weak solutions of Delta phi=omega, Hahn-Banach, elliptic regularity and Rellich; not the projection onto orthogonal complement of closure of d(Omega) with weak d,delta closedness. Analytic Thm 4.12 not proved. Same family as M. George notes.

sourceLabel: K. Sutrave, Heat equation proof of the Hodge theorem
evidence: Read: alpha_t closed, alpha_t-alpha=d(...) exact, spectral expansion, limit is harmonic projection, injectivity by <d beta,..>. Heat solution existence (Thm 4.1) is asserted, spectral decomposition only sketched, C^infty convergence not shown. Arapura Part II Sec 7.3 is only an outline.

preciseLocator: Prop 2B.6 and Cor 2B.7 (transfer sequence with Z2 coefficients)
evidence: Read: odd maps S^n->S^n have odd degree via Z2 transfer sequence, then Borsuk-Ulam by normalizing g(x)-g(-x) and restricting to equator which is nullhomotopic. Odd-degree mechanism uses transfer sequence not the cup power w^{n-1}; n=1 left to reader.
sketchProblem: Sketch's mechanism (w^{n-1}) differs from source; same degree-mod-2 route.

sourceLabel: Kuture et al., Proving Tucker's Lemma with a Volume Argument
evidence: Read: full proof of Tucker's lemma on triangulated cross-polytope (volume argument). The deduction of Borsuk-Ulam from Tucker (labeling by max coordinate, mesh to 0) is not in this or Prescott-Su math/0310444 or de Longueville-Zivaljevic, which only cite it.
sketchProblem: Sketch pulls back to hemisphere with arbitrary triangulation; Tucker as stated needs antipodally symmetric triangulation refining coordinate hyperplanes or a detour (de Longueville-Zivaljevic Sec 2).

sourceLabel: M. Singh, A simple proof of the Borsuk-Ulam theorem for Z_p-actions
evidence: Read: equivariant f:S^n->S^m with n>m; cohomology ring Z2[s]/s^{n+1} of RP^n; if f* nonzero on H^1 then s^{m+1}=0 contradiction; zero case excluded by lifting argument. Uses RP^n ring from Hatcher as known; does not derive the BU statement for f:S^n->R^n from nonexistence.
sketchProblem: Sketch asserts f* pulls w1 back to w1 directly; source needs separate lifting argument for the zero case.
